ChinaMedVisit Embeddable Cost Widget & SVG Badges

Zero-dependency Shadow DOM Web Component (<18 KB) and static SVG price badges built directly from verified 2026 Chinese Tier-3A IMC benchmarks.

Full Cost Calculator → 76 Tier-3A Hospitals → Bilingual Taxi Cards →

1. Interactive Web Component Configurator

Customize procedures, currency, theme, and publisher rel policy. Includes one clean brand link (Data source: ChinaMedVisit) to https://chinamedvisit.com/cost-calculator.
